title: An equivariant version of Gabber's lemma
summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, and let $k$ be an infinite perfect field containing a primitive root of unity of order the exponent of $G$. We prove that the $G$-equivariant version of Gabber's presentation lemma proposed by Bachmann holds over $k$ if and only if $G$ is cyclic of $p$-power order, for some prime $p$.
